column1: # Hand-checked gold links for the NT Latin alignment (Curran's five sample passages).
# Greek refs are chapter:verse:word_position in the shipped interlinear's SBLGNT.
# required: the Greek word(s) the Latin word translates (- = none: the Greek has no counterpart).
# acceptable: also correct if linked (the article of a noun it translates; the other half of a pair).
# A link is correct iff it is in required or acceptable. Recall counts required links only.
